name: saddle
note: Art sample (round 4): the summit saddle of the Tsuzura-ori pass. Origin = the great camphor's trunk. x east, z south, heights in metres relative to the saddle crown. The home (the house, the shrine, the graves, the garden) lies under the camphor's crown inside a ring of sacred woods (the barrier, zones.sanctum) with three gates: the main one (two standing stones and a rope) at the foot of the stone steps of the approach (sando) south of the tree, the north one on the way down to the spring, the south-west one at the yard's gate. The old road passes outside, east of the ring; paved with stones over the pass and on the hairpins of the ninety-nine bends, earth elsewhere, with stone-step shortcuts down the inside of two hairpins.
